title: Jeremy Kriegel — 'I never thought I'd be this freakin' excited about corporate governance!!'
summary: Jeremy Kriegel — UX and product strategist — publishes a punchy endorsement: Incorruptible corroborates the rot he's been ranting about AND offers a solution. Never thought he'd be this excited about corporate governance.
blockquote: Incorruptible is EXACTLY the book I needed right now. Not only does it corroborate the rot that I've been ranting about, but it offers a solution. I never thought I'd be this freakin' excited about corporate governance!!
